high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic showcasing various features of an Apple Watch. The layout is divided into several sections, each highlighting different aspects of the watch's capabilities. Retrospective ovulation estimates: An icon with a watch face displaying "TODAY, APR 1" and "Sleep Changes." Always-On display: A section with a graph labeled "Training load" and a recycling symbol indicating "100% recycled aluminum cases." Temperature sensing: An icon showing a watch face with a graph labeled "Past 7 Days" and "Wrist Temperature +2.
